## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `18600c34ebd25df7ed453be35d12311254783246`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json + packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts, packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.ts, packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/template.ts, packages/objectql/src/assignment-rules.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/assignment-rule-hooks.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-assignment-rule.object.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts, packages/spec/src/automation/assignment-rule.zod.ts, skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md, skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs, content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set of the `hits` files: `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` gains one paragraph in the `notify` section (the mail `option` formatter for a notice's select label, #30731) and one clause on the `assignTo: { type: 'user' }` sentence in "Assignment rules" (the active-member rule, #30826); it deletes the `## CRM Automation Blueprint` section, the When-to-Use restatement and the scaffolded-project `npm run validate` line. `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` appends case 15. No package code, no schema, no public export, no spec sentence changes — right, and `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` follow from it.
- Public surface: none. `TEMPLATE_FORMATTERS` / `MAIL_TEMPLATE_FORMATTERS` (template-engine.ts:191, 194) and every objectql / plugin-sharing export are untouched; the diff teaches what `main` already serves.
- Token ratchet row: 6449 to 6448. Read off the git objects (`wc -c`, no script run): the PR's SKILL.md is 25811 bytes, less the 20-byte `version:` stamp line, `ceil(25791 / 4) = 6448`; on `main` 25806 bytes gives 6447 under the old ceiling 6449 (headroom 2). The file grew by one token inside its headroom and the ceiling moved DOWN to the measurement, headroom 0 — the only direction the ratchet allows. Right. The row's comment names the three deletions that paid; each matches the diff.
- Remainder of the diff (the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT): `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx` (+7 lines) and the changeset. Read, not reviewed; see ③.
- Check-runs on `18600c34`: success — Build Core, Build Docs, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, Spec property liveness, Type Check (workspace, source gates, consumer gates, debt ledger, TypeScript), Lint (ESLint, repo & tooling gates, docs & code guards, PM dispatch-gates, CI/release & engine gates, scoped x3), Test UI, Live E2E UI, Test Core 1/8, 2/8, 3/8, 4/8 (the other shards and the rest skipped by path filter); only the `Test Core` umbrella job was still closing at render time. No failure, no cancellation. The ratchet, skill-identifier-liveness, pm-skill-id-lint, skill-docs and docs-single-h1 families live in the green Lint runs.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/30731-automation-skill-notify-label-and-org-assignment-rules.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. The only published package the diff touches is the skills bundle (`packages/skills/package.json` is `@objectstack/skills`); prose-only guidance in an already-taught skill is a patch, the same level the last three skills changesets on `main` took (#30821, #30764, #30682). The docs page, the eval fixture and the ratchet script publish nothing. Right.
- `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and the changeset: no capability is declared, widened or narrowed — the `option` formatter is #30727's `yes (widening)`, already landed; this PR only teaches it. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no metadata type or wire shape moves. Both right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: `[]` in the dev report (6679461131). Nothing to answer.
- Dev out-of-scope note 1 (no generated reference page for `sys_assignment_rule`, so the docs prose names its columns inline): read against `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-assignment-rule.object.ts` — the columns the page names (`object_name`, `criteria`, `recipient_type`, `recipient_id`, `strategy`, `load`, `active`, `sort_order`) are the object's. Correct as a read-only observation; a reference page is a separate card if anyone wants one. Not a blocker.
- Dev out-of-scope note 2 (first commit's git author spelled as the fleet bot): the squash on landing rewrites it; not a review matter.
- Docs page `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx` (READ, not reviewed). Every claim was checked against the code: order (authored first, `sort_order` then `name`, `localeCompare`, assignment-rules.ts:413-415; declared rules in registry order as the fallback, :369), first match wins (:449-455), the activation ledger has no organization column (:25-30, 660-678), one namespace by name with the declared rule answering and a `warnOnce` (:417-424; boot report at `error`, assignment-rule-hooks.ts:277-304), a failed read of the organization's rules routes nothing, not even by the fallback (:365-369, 402-412), `active: false` (:425), the `user` target honoured only for a `sys_member` row with no ban in force (:260-274), a lapsed target written ownerless with `queue` unset and `warnOnce` (:529-571), Setup → Assignment Rules under `manage_platform_settings` (sharing-plugin.ts:683), the save-guard list (assignment-rule-hooks.ts:14-21, 131-247; `strategy` on a user target and `least_loaded` without `load` refused by assignment-rule.zod.ts:82-110). It contradicts neither the skill (the skill's "(else ownerless)" is the page's "leaves it ownerless (`queue` unset)") nor the code, with ONE wording note for the lane seat: "can still be switched off or renamed" — `name` IS in `JUDGED_COLUMNS` (assignment-rule-hooks.ts:54-56), so a patch of `name` is re-judged and refused while the target is lapsed; only `label`, `description`, `sort_order` and `active` escape. The sentence inherits the source comment's own "rename" (hooks.ts:30-31); "relabelled" would be exact. Not in `hits`, so not a ④ finding.
- Ratchet row (READ): moves down only, 6449 to 6448, re-locked at the measurement; its comment agrees with the skill diff and with the code the deletions point to. No contradiction.
- Neighbour overlap with draft PR #30831 (seat 1, #30805): its SKILL.md hunk changes `main` line 319 (the `approvers` queue name becomes `crm_support_intake`) with lines 317-318 as unchanged context; this PR rewrites line 318 into two lines. Adjacent-line conflict, textual only — one edit renames a queue in an example, the other adds a clause about a user target; neither changes the other's meaning. #30831's eval edits (cases 3, 7, 9, 11, 12) do not touch case 14's closing brace where case 15 is spliced in. Whichever lands second must re-measure the ratchet: this PR leaves headroom 0, and #30831 also changes the file's byte count (it drops "The third automation family: " and adds `crm_` prefixes).
- Tier H approval and the queue guard are whole-PR and outside this record.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, the `notify` paragraph (lines 130-133), word by word against `main`:

- "`{{ stage | option:opportunity.stage }}` in the mail `template`": the spelling PR #30727 landed and card #30731 asked for; the argument is the bare `object.field` form `optionFieldReference` accepts (template-engine.ts:306-322, `OPTION_FIELD_RE`); quoted, marked and one-sided forms are refused as `option-field-shape` (:546-553) and are not taught. Holds.
- "each recipient's language": plugin-email builds the label table per send in the send's own `locale` (email-service.ts:1512, 1611-1614, PR #30781), which the channels pass per recipient after fan-out (notify-node.ts:856, 1140-1148). Holds.
- "mail-only, refused in inline `title` / `message`": `MAIL_ONLY_FORMATTERS = ['option']` (template-engine.ts:184), excluded from `TEMPLATE_FORMATTERS` (:191), the in-app dialect refuses it as `known-formatter` with the mail-only sentence (:533-544); an inline `title` / `message` goes through `renderTextSlot` → `templateEngine.evaluate`, whose parse refusal throws `FlowTextTemplateError` (template.ts:131-140, template-engine.ts:706-707), and the lint judges the same slots. Holds.
- "never `label()` in `templateData`, evaluated once per run, before fan-out": `templateData` is a value-slot map resolved once at node execution (`resolveValueSlotMap`, notify-node.ts:983-990) and snapshotted into each delivery's payload (:1140-1156); `label()` is the formula-field macro (stdlib.ts:18-19, 414-418). Holds.
- Placement: directly under the `notify` config block, before "Flow Variables" — where the card said the line goes.

`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, the `assignTo: { type: 'user' }` clause (lines 322-324): "names one owner, who holds the row only while an active member of its organization (else ownerless)". `routeToUser` (assignment-rules.ts:529-571) asks `organizationMemberStanding` (:260-274: a `sys_member` row in that organization and no ban in force) of every user target at insert, declared rules included (:369, 478-480); `member` writes `owner_id`, anything else leaves the row ownerless, `warnOnce`, never a refused insert. The one line the card allowed grew into two and was paid for in the same file. Holds. Tried to break it: "its organization" could be read as the user's organization; the row's organization is meant and is what the docs page spells out — the skill's budget does not carry the longer form, and the two agree. Not a finding.

`skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json`, case 15, against the card's scenario and the evals' convention:

- The card asked for "a notice that prints a select field's label"; the prompt is that (a stalled-opportunity e-mail whose subject shows `stage` as its label in each recipient's language), the expected output names the right form and both wrong forms with the reason the code gives (once per run, mail-only). Matches the code read above.
- Shape: `id`, `prompt`, `expected_output`, `files: []`, `assertions.must_contain` / `must_not_contain` — the shape of cases 1-14; ids 1-15 contiguous; the file parses (15 cases). Spliced before the closing bracket, no other case reformatted.
- `must_contain` tokens are each a whole token in the bundle's own markdown as `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` scores them (`SCAN_ROOTS = ['skills']`, bundle-wide oracle, `wholeTokenPattern`): `option:opportunity.stage` and `once per run` only in the new paragraph, `template` throughout. `must_not_contain`: `source: 'label(` and `| label` are the two spellings a right answer never writes; neither appears in the bundle's own guidance for a notice.
- Observations, not findings: `template` is a weak positive (an answer that wrongly puts `label()` in `templateData` carries it too) — the two negatives do the grading, the pattern of cases 2 and 14; `| label` would also red a markdown table cell starting with `label`, an accepted cost of the convention (case 9's `](`).

Deletions that paid for the growth, each checked for a surviving home:

1. `## CRM Automation Blueprint` (main 424-430): the `src/flows/*.flow.ts` → `src/flows/index.ts` → `defineStack({ flows })` layout is `skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md:53-74` ("Barrel Import Pattern", `import * as flows from './src/flows'`, `flows: Object.values(flows)`); explicit `variables` and `nodes` + `edges` are the skill's own "Flow Variables" section and the examples reference; the frontmatter still names `*.flow.ts` as the load trigger. No other file on `main` or in the PR tree references the heading or its anchor (only the new changeset names it). "Lifecycle first" was an ordering preference, not a rule.
2. "When to Use" (main 25-27): "that route a new record to a queue or a person" survives as the section heading (PR line 298); "scheduled automation" survives as "Flows (auto-launched, screen, scheduled)" three words earlier and the `schedule` row of the Flow Types table.
3. "In a scaffolded project: `npm run validate`." (main 443): `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md:476` carries it in its Verify section, which this skill names for CEL validation at its top; five other skills carry it too.

No rule is left without a home. No must-fix, no should-fix.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-automation` 技能补两处。① `notify` 一节加一段：通知里要显示下拉字段的标签，用邮件模板的 `option` 格式化（按每位收件人的语言输出），不要在 `templateData` 里用 `label()`（它在分发给收件人之前只算一次）。② "Assignment rules" 里 `assignTo: { type: 'user' }` 一句补上：只有当该用户仍是记录所在组织的有效成员时才归他，否则记录无人负责。文档 `queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx` 加一节讲组织自建的分配规则（`sys_assignment_rule`）：先于栈内声明的规则执行，按 `sort_order` 再按名字排序，首个匹配胜出；读不到组织规则时不路由；用户目标须为有效成员。测试题加第 15 题。
- 为什么改：PR #30727/#30781 已上线邮件 `option` 格式化，PR #30760 已上线组织自建分配规则，但技能和文档都没写，AI 会继续用 `label()` 或以为分配规则只能声明。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文本、一道测试题、一页文档和 changeset，不碰运行时。篇幅靠同文件删除换来（CRM Automation Blueprint 一节，内容在 platform 的 bootstrap.md；When-to-Use 的重复句；`npm run validate` 一行），token 上限 6449 下调到实测 6448，没有上调。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 的 `notify` 段与 `assignTo` 一句。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "option:" skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`。
- 需要你做的：改的是 `skills/**`，属于 Tier H，需要 os-zhuang（或 hotlong）批准后才能合并。契约复审 PASS 记录 6679652026。

席位意见：契约复审 PASS，无必改、无建议修改。席位在文档里查出一处错（"可以改名"，实际改名会被重新校验），已改。可以批准。

## 席位核对

1. **Shape:** `Fixes #30731`, `Fixes #30826` (fold, both edit `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`), draft, base `main`, 5 files (`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` case 15, `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx`, `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` one row 6449 → 6448, `.changeset/30731-automation-skill-notify-label-and-org-assignment-rules.md` `'@objectstack/skills': patch`), +51/−14, three commits.
2. **Ruling:** #30731: ruling F parameter 6 on #30172 (maintainer 「同意」, recorded 6670405874); triage 6673659456. #30826: the `Skills-docs:` follow-up of PR #30760; triage 6678081998. Claims 6678887018, 6678901809. Ceiling moved down only.
3. **Contract review:** PASS `6679652026` at `18600c34` (Fable, no must-fix, no should-fix). The head moved to `c864cad6` by one prose-only commit on `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx` (one line, outside the review's `hits`), so the record carries on under the prose-face exception. Regen-provenance: `18600c34` → `c864cad6`, prose face only (`git diff 18600c34 c864cad6 --stat`: 1 file, +1/−1). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
4. **Docs (seat's prose face, checked line by line against main):** the organization-rule paragraph matches `packages/objectql/src/assignment-rules.ts` and plugin-sharing (`sort_order` then `name`, first match across both sources, a failed read routes nothing, `user` target only while an active member). The seat's one finding: "can still be switched off or renamed" was wrong (`name` is in `JUDGED_COLUMNS`, plugin-sharing `assignment-rule-hooks.ts`, so a rename is judged again); it now reads "switched off, re-ordered or relabelled; a rename … is judged again".

On head `c864cad6`: 45 check-runs, 33 success, 12 skipped, 0 failed; mergeable_state clean.
